feeds.title: Bucharest Real Estate Club Blog
feeds.description: In the midst of a new stage of development for Southeast European (SEE) cities, with ever-positive prospects, new local & regional capital emerging, and large international platforms have made major steps in the region, Bucharest Real Estate Club has set - up to foster cross-regional business development, facilitate valuable connections building and impactful deals origination.

feeds.title: Investing in Property
feeds.description: INVESTING in PROPERTY is part of the company that has constantly redefined the standards for the last 18 years in the business media devoted to law. Andrei Cristea is the Director of Lion House, He made innovation the journalistic and management credo of these almost 20 years of business, in which he launched the Romanian Consulting Magazine, the website LegalMarketing.ro, and the TV show 'Business Laws'. Look out for more information on the website.

feeds.title: HomeZZ Blog
feeds.description: Home is where we feel best, where we can be fully ourselves and feel safest. We created this platform out of the desire to give everyone the chance to find this little corner of heaven. HomeZZ.ro is more than a real estate platform. It's where you find support, support, and information.

feeds.title: Real Estate Magazine
feeds.description: Real Estate is published by the Grafor Design trust, a publisher whose experience is confirmed by the titles Luxury, Connect, Photo Magazine, Desire, or JW Marriott Journal. The magazine offers a perspective on all business or vocational fields that converge towards maintaining the dynamism of the real estate market.

feeds.title: Palace Estate Blog
feeds.description: Palace Estate is committed to helping you, our client, to find the best real estate properties and to assist you in relocating or developing your project in the north of Bucharest. Good reputation and services have been the driving force behind our real estate development agency. Find the latest articles on our site about comparing and selling properties.

feeds.title: The Romania Journal » Real Estate
feeds.description: The Romania Journal is an English-language online paper bringing you headline news from Romania's politics, society, business, and culture, practically filling you in on the latest stories and reports from Romania's day-to-day life. Discover various facts and news about the real estate world!

feeds.title: Fortim Trusted Advisors
feeds.description: At Fortim Trusted Advisors, we put our clients at the heart of all we do. We are committed to deliver the highest level of expertise across the full range of real estate services. Read daily updates about the retail business in the press release section on the site.

feeds.title: Bucharest Apartments Blog
feeds.description: Bucharest Apartment is the ultimate website for short and long-apartment rentals in Bucharest as well as for finding the best boutique hotels and hostels for your stay in the Romanian capital city. If you are looking for an accommodation solution, whether this is for a few days, a few months, or longer, you can use the website in full confidence.

feeds.title: Maurer Imobiliare News
feeds.description: We build your dream, Together we write the future. Beyond housing, we set out to offer our customers a lifestyle. The communities built by Maurer Imobiliare in the key points of Romania end up looking like real cities within cities, ideal places for young families, oases of peace for the elderly - offering an atmosphere of unity and communion. Explore the news and blogs for recent updates taking place in a certain period of time and many more.
